style: real top-down studio photograph, warm natural colour, plain white background
themeWhy: the fist is natural brown skin: dark-brown keys in its own family and a berry Enter as the treat, the same keys as the other time tools; clear of the sky blue, amber, vermilion, deep blue and green the tool keeps for meaning

images.object: closed right fist, back of the hand, brown skin, knuckles along the top
images.why: Stage phase 2, 'two flat drawn fists stand side by side at x 600, y 230' (owner 2026-10-28: a real photo of a closed fist). ONE photo of a closed RIGHT fist, back of the hand to the viewer, thumb tucked at its LEFT side, wrist ending in a flat edge at the bottom. TILE 146 x 220 px (aspect 0.664): draw it at 146 x 220 or scaled UNIFORMLY (e.g. 160 x 241), never into a 240 x 220 box (<Skin> slices and would crop it). Drawn once per hand; the second hand is the SAME skin mirrored (x -> 146 - x), so its thumb is at the right. Marks (31 / 30, dots, labels) are drawn in code over it, never in the picture. Coordinates in the tile's own px, as made, left to right: KNUCKLES (centre of each rounded finger-top hump) K1 (44,16) K2 (75,16) K3 (103,26) K4 (130,40); DIPS (the dark slits or valleys between humps) D1 (59,22) D2 (90,28) D3 (118,36). Order along the fist: K1 D1 K2 D2 K3 D3 K4 (about 3 px tolerance; D1 and D2 are narrow slits about 4 px wide, D3 a soft valley). The plain code-drawn fist stays UNDER the skin as the fallback.
images.prompt: A right hand closed into a fist, lying with the back of the hand facing straight up at the camera: the smooth, evenly lit back of the hand fills the picture, a straight level row of rounded knuckle bones runs across its top edge with a shallow dip between each, the fingers curl away downwards from the knuckles out of sight so that no fingertips, nails or palm show, the thumb is tucked against the side, and the wrist ends in a clean flat edge at the bottom. Natural medium-brown skin with fine real skin texture.
